title: BUY THE DIP! 5 Hot Stocks to Buy Now (November's Top Picks With Upside Ahead)
creator: MarketBeat
summary: MarketBeat guest analyst Thomas Hughes presents five November buy-the-dip picks against a mixed market in which heavy AI spending and debt have pushed quality stocks to historic low valuations, while third-quarter reports show AI monetisation and free cash flow starting to arrive. Oracle is his top execution story: backlog far exceeds spending and is converting to cash flow, leaving the stock trading as if the business will fail, with analyst targets cited from $110 to $400. Salesforce has flipped from a SaaS-apocalypse meltdown to a melt-up, with agentic AI growing customers, deepening penetration and widening margins at double-digit growth. Zscaler, a first tracked MarketBeat call, benefits from AI-driven security demand and a rebuilt sales team, though roughly 50 times current-year outlook is a near-term valuation concern. Applied Digital is bringing data-centre capacity online and monetising it, with cash flow and margins improving and contracts backed by upfront capital, after falling below $20 from a May peak near $50. Amprius Technologies, also first tracked, has moved from speculation to execution on a recent $75 million government contract, with capacity and revenue ramping toward profitability in two to three quarters. Hughes also expects election-related volatility of perhaps 5 to 10% before stability returns.

calls.bear_case: AI spending and debt remain the hurdle; near-term headwinds persist while the build-out continues.
